visuals.question: Which reliability method reaches the exact failure probability, at what cost?
visuals.type: dot plot with 95% intervals and a reference line
visuals.alt: Failure probability of five methods against the exact value; SORM sits on the exact line.

visuals.question: How well do the samplers recover an exact posterior spread?
visuals.alt: Posterior standard deviation error of six methods; only mean-field ADVI is far off.

visuals.question: Which block causes the lander's mission failures?
visuals.alt: Criticality importance of the four most important blocks; the transponder dominates.

visuals.question: How much of its own deviation does a batch keep under partial pooling, by number of tests?
visuals.type: line (closed-form share) with fitted points and two reference lines
visuals.alt: Share of the raw batch deviation kept by the BLUP against tests per batch; small batches keep little, large batches most.

visuals.question: How much does the sampling design change the error at equal cost?
visuals.alt: Relative error of the Ishigami mean for four designs at equal runs; Sobol' is smallest.
